## 1 概述 / Overview
`dsh-ohos-shell` 是 deepseek-harness 的捆绑包（bundle）。它面向 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 设备，用于补齐子进程的运行环境。
`dsh-ohos-shell` is a bundle for deepseek-harness. It targets HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony devices. It
completes the runtime environment of child processes.
本包只在 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 上生效。其它平台上两行 Host 插件拒绝运行，环境保持不变。
This package acts on HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony only. On every other platform both Host plugin rows r
efuse to run and the environment stays unchanged.
捆绑包向 profile 插入两行 Host 插件。
The bundle inserts two Host plugin rows into the profile.
| 行 | 作用 |

| `ohos-shell-env` | 把运行环境写入主进程的 `process.env`，卸载时还原。 |
| `ohos-shell-facts` | 通过 `ctx.shellEnv` 发布同
样的信息（`DSH_OHOS*`），供模型 shell 读取。 |
| Row | Function |
| `ohos-shell-env` | Writes the environment into the host process `process.env`. It restores the val

ue at unload. |
| `ohos-shell-facts` | Publishes the same facts through `ctx.shellEnv` (`DSH_OHOS*`)
for model shell calls. |
## 2 适用背景 / Background
鸿蒙不是普通的 Linux 主机。下面五项差异会影响 Harness 的子进程。
HarmonyOS is not a standard Linux host. Five differences below affect Harness child processes.

配置：没有别名、函数、补全与提示符。它既不是 bash，也不是 zsh。 |
| `/etc/shells` 不存在 | Harness 的 shell 发现没有注册表可查。 |
| `/tmp` 只

读 | 必须有可写的 `TMPDIR`，否则 `os.tmpdir()` 返回 `/tmp`。 |
| 应用沙箱 uid（2000xxxx）不在 `/etc/passwd` 中 | Node 的 `o

s.userInfo()` 抛出 `uv_os_get_passwd ENOENT`。Node 命令行工具调用它时不加 `try`/`catch`。 |
| zsh 未随包发行函数库 | `fpath
` 指向构建机，上游 281 个函数中只有 3 个存在，Harness 的 zsh 集成因此无法 autoload 所需函数。见 5.3 节。 |
| Fact | Consequence |
| `SHELL=/bin/sh`, and `/bin/sh` is mksh (MirBSD Korn Shell) | mksh reads `${ENV:-~/.mkshrc}`. That
file does not exist, so mksh reads no configuration. It has no aliases, functions, completions, or p

rompt. It is not bash and not zsh. |

s no registry to read. |
| `/tmp` is read-only | A writable `TMPDIR` is necessary. Without it, `os.t

erInfo()` throws `uv_os_get_passwd ENOENT`. Node command-line tools call it without a `try`/`catch`.

|
| zsh ships without its function library | `fpath` points at the build machine. Only 3 of the 281
upstream functions exist, so the Harness zsh integration cannot autoload the functions it needs. Se

## 3 环境要求 / Requirements
运行前请确认以下条件：
Make sure that these conditions are true:

- 设备运行 HarmonyOS 或 OpenHarmony。这是硬条件：插件在激活时自行判定平台，其它平台上两行插件拒绝运行，各记录一条 `error`，环境保持不变。
- 已安装 harmonyb

rew，前缀默认为 `~/.harmonybrew`。
- 已通过 harmonybrew 安装 deepseek-harness。
- 系统提供 `/usr/bin/zsh`。
- The device runs HarmonyOS or OpenHarmony. This is a hard condition. Each plugin row decides the pl
atform at activation. On every other platform both rows refuse to run, each one logs an `error`, and

the environment stays unchanged.
- harmonybrew is installed. The default prefix is `~/.harmonybrew`

.
- deepseek-harness is installed through harmonybrew.
- The system provides `/usr/bin/zsh`.
